title: Aktuelle Themen zu Quantennetzwerken (TUM, Modul NAT5008m)
titleEn: Current Topics in Quantum Networks (TUM, Module NAT5008m)
description: In this seminar, we will discuss recent publications in the field of quantum science and technology, with a focus on networked quantum systems. To this end, each student will read one paper per week, which will then be discussed in the seminar. In addition, each student will prepare a presentation about a research highlight. The learning outcome will be evaluated based on this presentation, with a focus on the clarity and quality of the presentation, as well as the response to arising questions.In the preparation of the talk, the students will be supported by members of the Quantum Networks Group.
